Niesant Alvares

Niesant Alvares is the Founder and CEO of Ness Sport Global, a platform working across sports management, commercial growth, media, and investment.

He is a sports entrepreneur, executive, early-stage investor, and global strategy advisor dedicated to building and backing the future of global sport, media, and consumer ecosystems.

His operational background spans sports advisory, high-performance ecosystem design, cricket operations, player development, and the scaling of global sports business models.

Alongside his operating roles, he manages a private early-stage investment portfolio focused on Pre-Seed and Seed companies across SportsTech, Media, Entertainment, and high-growth technology. He brings strategic advisory, go-to-market mentorship, and institutional networking to help founders build with intent and scale globally.
